distribution.narrative: Lin & Beaver (2024) described Indocryphalus chiyui from Taichung City, Heping District, Taiwan. Taiwan occurrence is confirmed from the type series; no mainland-China occurrence is reported.

host_note: The original description directly reports adults and larvae from unhealthy branches and twigs of Castanopsis cuspidata var. carlesii. This host is promoted at the exact taxonomic resolution used in the source.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Indocryphalus chiyui Lin & Beaver, 2024.

taxonomic_history.name: Indocryphalus chiyui
taxonomic_history.note: Current accepted name in the integrated taxonomic backbone.

nomenclature_note: Indocryphalus chiyui Lin & Beaver was described as a new species in 2024 and maps directly to pre-existing integrated taxonomic backbone identity VSN_3382. No duplicate VSN is created.
